title: Young Adults
subtitle: 處於成年早期的人；成年初期人士
description: 處於成年早期的人；成年初期人士

words.meaning: 處於成年早期的人；成年初期人士
words.note: 這是 young adults 很直接、清楚的解釋性改寫，特別適合研究、教育、健康或正式寫作。它強調人生階段，而不是某個固定年齡界線。
words.example: The programme focuses on people in early adulthood who are moving into independent living.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃針對正進入獨立生活的成年早期人士。

exercises.original: The study examines how young adults adjust to independent living after leaving the family home.
exercises.zh: 研究探討年輕成年人離開家庭住所後如何適應獨立生活。
exercises.upgrade: people in early adulthood · 處於成年早期的人；成年初期人士

options.explanation: teenagers = 青少年。部分 18–19 歲人士可同時是 teen，但 young adults 的範圍通常更廣。
people in early adulthood = 處於成年早期的人。independent living after leaving home 是典型成年初期議題。
middle-aged adults = 中年成年人。年齡階段不同。
schoolchildren = 學童。範圍太年幼。
minors = 未成年人。法律身份不同，而且很多 young adults 已成年。
older adults = 年長成年人。人生階段相反。

exercises.original: The clinic offers mental-health support specifically for young adults beginning work or university.
exercises.zh: 診所專門為剛開始工作或大學生活的年輕成年人提供心理健康支援。
exercises.upgrade: people in early adulthood · 處於成年早期的人；成年初期人士

options.explanation: adolescents only = 只指青少年。不能涵蓋完整成年初期群體。
youngsters = 年輕人／小孩。太口語且常偏年幼。
older workers = 年長工作者。明顯不合。
people in transition generally = 一般處於轉變中的人。範圍太廣。
people in early adulthood = 成年早期人士。beginning work or university 是典型成年初期生活轉換。
children = 兒童。年齡不符。

exercises.original: Housing costs can be especially difficult for young adults who are just starting to support themselves.
exercises.zh: 對剛開始經濟獨立的年輕成年人來說，住屋成本可能特別困難。
exercises.upgrade: people in early adulthood · 處於成年早期的人；成年初期人士

options.explanation: people in early adulthood = 成年早期人士。just starting to support themselves 是典型成年初期語境。
teenagers only = 只指十多歲人士。範圍太窄。
middle-aged people = 中年人。不同人生階段。
children = 兒童。明顯不合。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。
minors = 未成年人。法律概念不等於成年初期。

words.note: 當 young adults 是和 middle-aged / older adults 等較年長成人群體作比較時，可用 younger adults。它是相對年齡概念，因此需要比較背景。
words.example: Younger adults were more likely than older adults to use the app daily.
words.exampleZh: 較年輕成年人比年長成年人更可能每天使用這個應用。

exercises.original: Young adults were much more likely than older adults to stream music every day.
exercises.zh: 年輕成年人比年長成年人更可能每天串流音樂。
exercises.upgrade: younger adults · 較年輕的成年人

options.explanation: teenagers = 青少年。未必都是成年人。
middle-aged adults = 中年成年人。和 older adults 比較方向不符。
older users = 年長使用者。和原句相反。
younger adults = 較年輕成年人。than older adults 是最直接比較線索。
minors = 未成年人。不是成年組別。
school-age people = 學齡人士。太年幼。

exercises.original: The survey found that young adults exercise more often than respondents over sixty.
exercises.zh: 調查發現，年輕成年人比六十歲以上受訪者更常做運動。
exercises.upgrade: younger adults · 較年輕的成年人

options.explanation: children = 兒童。不是成人樣本。
adolescents = 青少年。發展階段不同。
younger adults = 較年輕成年人。comparison with respondents over sixty 是典型相對年齡用法。
retirees = 退休人士。年齡方向相反。
middle-aged respondents = 中年受訪者。可能屬較年輕成人，但不等於題目指的 young adults。
minors = 未成年人。法律身份錯。

exercises.original: Doctors noticed that young adults recovered faster than the oldest patients in the study.
exercises.zh: 醫生注意到，較年輕成年人比研究中最年長的病人康復得更快。
exercises.upgrade: younger adults · 較年輕的成年人

options.explanation: teenagers only = 只指青少年。不能代表整個成年群體。
children = 兒童。不是 adult patient group。
middle-aged patients only = 只指中年人。過度收窄。
older adults = 年長成年人。和 fastest recovery group 相反。
minors = 未成年人。不是成人分類。
younger adults = 較年輕成年人。contrasted with oldest patients 是決定性線索。

words.meaning: 新興成年期人士；正進入成年階段的人
words.note: emerging adults 是發展心理學常用術語，通常指從青春後期到二十多歲、正在探索身份、工作、關係和獨立生活的階段。它不是一般日常 young adults 的通用替換。
words.example: The research examines identity development among emerging adults.
words.exampleZh: 研究探討新興成年期人士的身份發展。

exercises.original: The psychology study follows young adults as they explore identity, relationships, work, and independence.
exercises.zh: 心理學研究追蹤年輕成年人探索身份、關係、工作和獨立生活的過程。
exercises.upgrade: schoolchildren · 新興成年期人士；正進入成年階段的人

options.explanation: older adults = 年長成年人。發展階段不同。
emerging adults = 新興成年期人士。identity + relationships + work + independence 是典型發展心理學框架。
minors = 未成年人。法律概念不同。
middle-aged adults = 中年人。不是正在進入成年。
schoolchildren = 學童。太年幼。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。

exercises.original: Researchers use the term young adults for participants aged eighteen to twenty-five who are still moving toward stable adult roles.
exercises.zh: 研究人員用年輕成年人指十八至二十五歲、仍逐步建立穩定成年角色的參與者。
exercises.upgrade: emerging adults · 新興成年期人士；正進入成年階段的人

options.explanation: youngsters = 年輕人／小孩。非技術用語且太模糊。
emerging adults = 新興成年期人士。18–25 + moving toward stable adult roles 是典型研究定義。
older adults = 年長成年人。明顯不合。
children = 兒童。年齡不符。
minors only = 只指未成年人。18–25 中很多已成年。
middle-aged adults = 中年成年人。不同階段。

exercises.original: The article discusses young adults who are still experimenting with career paths and long-term relationships.
exercises.zh: 文章討論仍在探索職涯方向和長期關係的年輕成年人。
exercises.upgrade: emerging adults · 新興成年期人士；正進入成年階段的人

options.explanation: emerging adults = 新興成年期人士。career exploration + relationships 是核心特徵。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。
children = 兒童。太年幼。
older workers = 年長工作者。無關。
minors = 未成年人。法律身份不能涵蓋整個群體。
middle-aged adults = 中年人。不同人生階段。

words.note: young people 比 young adults 更廣，可包括青少年和年輕成年人。因此只有在上下文已明確成人身份，或不需要精確年齡界線時，才適合作較自然的改寫。
words.example: The programme helps young people move from education into full-time work.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃幫助年輕人由教育階段過渡到全職工作。

exercises.original: The housing service supports young adults aged eighteen to twenty-four who are living independently for the first time.
exercises.zh: 住屋服務支援十八至二十四歲、首次獨立生活的年輕人。
exercises.upgrade: young people · 年輕人；青年

options.explanation: children = 兒童。18–24 不合。
teenagers only = 只指十多歲人士。不能涵蓋 20–24。
young people = 年輕人。age eighteen to twenty-four 已限制成人／青年範圍，因此自然。
minors = 未成年人。18–24 多數已成年。
older adults = 年長成年人。相反。
pupils = 學童。身份不符。

exercises.original: The employment programme helps young adults leaving university find their first full-time jobs.
exercises.zh: 就業計劃幫助剛大學畢業的年輕人找到第一份全職工作。
exercises.upgrade: young people · 年輕人；青年

options.explanation: schoolchildren = 學童。大學畢業語境不合。
minors = 未成年人。大學畢業者通常已成年。
teenagers only = 青少年。不能涵蓋一般大學畢業者。
older adults = 年長成年人。不同群體。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。
young people = 年輕人。leaving university + first full-time jobs 已清楚限定青年成人語境。

exercises.original: The charity offers budgeting workshops to young adults who have recently started earning their own income.
exercises.zh: 慈善機構為剛開始有自己收入的年輕人提供理財工作坊。
exercises.upgrade: young people · 年輕人；青年

options.explanation: older workers = 年長工作者。不是剛開始有收入的群體。
children = 兒童。一般不符合 earning own income 的主要語境。
minors only = 未成年人。過窄。
young people = 年輕人。recently started earning own income 已清楚提供成年過渡背景。
school pupils = 學童。太窄。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。

words.word: People In Their Late Teens And Twenties
words.meaning: 十多歲後期至二十多歲的人
words.note: 當上下文對 young adults 的年齡範圍有明確需要時，可直接用 people in their late teens and twenties。這是精準的描述性改寫，但只適合實際範圍確實如此的情況。
words.example: The survey focuses on people in their late teens and twenties.
words.exampleZh: 這項調查聚焦十多歲後期至二十多歲人士。

exercises.original: In this report, young adults are defined as people aged eighteen to twenty-nine.
exercises.zh: 在這份報告中，年輕成年人被定義為十八至二十九歲人士。
exercises.upgrade: children · 十多歲後期至二十多歲的人

options.text: people in their late teens and twenties
options.explanation: people in their late teens and twenties = 十多歲後期至二十多歲人士。18–29 正好對應這個描述。
children = 兒童。年齡不符。
middle-aged adults = 中年成年人。年齡不符。
older adults = 年長成年人。相反。
minors only = 只指未成年人。18–29 絕大部分已成年。
teenagers only = 只指十多歲。不能涵蓋二十多歲。

exercises.original: The event is aimed at young adults between eighteen and twenty-nine rather than teenagers generally.
exercises.zh: 活動對象是十八至二十九歲的年輕成年人，而不是一般青少年。
exercises.upgrade: people in their late teens and twenties · 十多歲後期至二十多歲的人
exercises.answer: people in their late teens and twenties

options.text: people in their late teens and twenties
options.explanation: people in their late teens and twenties = 十多歲後期至二十多歲的人。18–29 的年齡範圍非常清楚。
school-age people = 學齡人士。太年幼。
children = 兒童。錯。
older workers = 年長工作者。錯。
minors = 未成年人。不能涵蓋 18–29。
teenagers only = 只指青少年。句子已明說 rather than teenagers generally。

exercises.original: The magazine mainly targets young adults aged nineteen to twenty-eight.
exercises.zh: 這本雜誌主要針對十九至二十八歲的年輕成年人。
exercises.upgrade: people in their late teens and twenties · 十多歲後期至二十多歲的人
exercises.answer: people in their late teens and twenties

options.explanation: teenagers = 青少年。只涵蓋十九歲，不含二十多歲。
middle-aged readers = 中年讀者。年齡不符。
older adults = 年長成年人。錯。
children = 兒童。錯。

options.text: people in their late teens and twenties
options.explanation: people in their late teens and twenties = 十多歲後期至二十多歲人士。19–28 完整符合。
minors = 未成年人。大部分目標讀者已成年。

words.note: 當 young adults 在特定上下文明確只指二十多歲人士時，可用 adults in their twenties。這不是完整通用同義詞，因為 young adults 有時也包括十八、十九歲或三十歲出頭。
words.example: The campaign is designed for adults in their twenties.
words.exampleZh: 這項活動是為二十多歲成年人而設。

exercises.original: The survey's young-adult group includes only respondents aged twenty to twenty-nine.
exercises.zh: 調查中的年輕成年人組別只包括二十至二十九歲受訪者。
exercises.upgrade: middle-aged adults · 二十多歲的成年人

options.explanation: teenagers = 青少年。20–29 不屬 teen。
adults in their twenties = 二十多歲成年人。20–29 是直接定義。
minors = 未成年人。錯。
older adults = 年長成年人。錯。
schoolchildren = 學童。錯。
middle-aged adults = 中年人。錯。

exercises.original: The article looks at debt among young adults aged twenty-two to twenty-nine.
exercises.zh: 文章探討二十二至二十九歲年輕成年人的債務問題。
exercises.upgrade: adults in their twenties · 二十多歲的成年人

options.explanation: teenagers = 青少年。年齡不符。
children = 兒童。錯。
adults in their twenties = 二十多歲成年人。22–29 完整符合。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。
minors = 未成年人。錯。
older adults = 年長成年人。錯。

exercises.original: The service is intended for young adults from twenty-one to twenty-nine who are renting for the first time.
exercises.zh: 這項服務是為二十一至二十九歲、首次租屋的年輕成年人而設。
exercises.upgrade: adults in their twenties · 二十多歲的成年人

options.explanation: minors = 未成年人。21–29 明顯不符。
teenagers = 青少年。不含二十多歲。
older people = 年長人士。相反。
adults in their twenties = 二十多歲成年人。21–29 是精準範圍。
school leavers only = 剛離校者。身份不等同年齡。
children = 兒童。錯。

words.word: People At The Start Of Adult Life
words.meaning: 剛開始成年生活的人；處於成年人生起點的人
words.note: 這是一個自然、解釋性的片語，適合當 young adults 的重點是第一次工作、搬離家庭、建立關係、管理金錢等『剛踏入成人生活』的經驗，而不是精確年齡。
words.example: The course teaches financial skills to people at the start of adult life.
words.exampleZh: 這門課向剛開始成年生活的人教授理財技能。

exercises.original: The guide is written for young adults who are handling rent, bills, and full-time work for the first time.
exercises.zh: 這本指南是寫給首次處理租金、帳單和全職工作的年輕成年人。
exercises.upgrade: people at the start of adult life · 剛開始成年生活的人；處於成年人生起點的人
exercises.answer: people at the start of adult life

options.text: people at the start of adult life
options.explanation: people at the start of adult life = 剛開始成年生活的人。first time handling rent, bills, full-time work 是非常典型。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。
middle-aged parents = 中年父母。不同階段。
schoolchildren = 學童。太年幼。
older adults = 年長成年人。相反。
minors only = 只指未成年人。不能代表成年生活。

exercises.original: The bank created a simple savings product for young adults opening their first independent accounts.
exercises.zh: 銀行為首次開立個人獨立帳戶的年輕成年人推出簡單儲蓄產品。
exercises.upgrade: people at the start of adult life · 剛開始成年生活的人；處於成年人生起點的人
exercises.answer: people at the start of adult life

options.explanation: teenagers only = 只指青少年。太窄。
older customers = 年長客戶。相反。
middle-aged adults = 中年成年人。不是 first independent account 的典型目標描述。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。

options.text: people at the start of adult life
options.explanation: people at the start of adult life = 成年生活起步人士。first independent accounts 是決定性線索。
children = 兒童。錯。

exercises.original: The workshop helps young adults learn how to manage work, housing, and everyday responsibilities on their own.
exercises.zh: 工作坊幫助年輕成年人學習如何獨自處理工作、住屋和日常責任。
exercises.upgrade: people at the start of adult life · 剛開始成年生活的人；處於成年人生起點的人
exercises.answer: people at the start of adult life

options.explanation: youngsters only = 年幼者。太偏兒童／青少年。

options.text: people at the start of adult life
options.explanation: people at the start of adult life = 剛開始成年生活的人。work + housing + independent responsibilities 是直接線索。
older adults = 年長成年人。相反。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。
children = 兒童。錯。
middle-aged professionals = 中年專業人士。不同人生階段。

words.meaning: 年輕大人；年輕成年人（較口語）
words.note: young grown-ups 是可理解但較口語、帶生活化甚至有點親切的說法，常見於把年輕成人和 children 對比的語境。正式研究、政策和專業寫作通常仍較適合 young adults。
words.example: The family gathering had activities for children and young grown-ups alike.
words.exampleZh: 家庭聚會同時有適合小孩和年輕大人的活動。

exercises.original: The family holiday included separate activities for children, teenagers, and young adults.
exercises.zh: 家庭假期分別安排了兒童、青少年和年輕大人的活動。
exercises.upgrade: minors · 年輕大人；年輕成年人（較口語）

options.explanation: older adults = 年長成年人。不是 young adults。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。
young grown-ups = 年輕大人。family context + contrast with children and teenagers 是較自然的口語使用情境。
minors = 未成年人。young adults 通常已成年。
schoolchildren = 學童。太年幼。
middle-aged guests = 中年賓客。不同群體。

exercises.original: The magazine uses a friendly tone aimed at teens and young adults rather than formal professional language.
exercises.zh: 這本雜誌以友善語氣面向青少年和年輕成年人，而不是使用正式專業語言。
exercises.upgrade: young grown-ups · 年輕大人；年輕成年人（較口語）

options.explanation: emerging adults formally = 正式心理學術語。和 friendly informal tone 不匹配。
older people = 年長人士。錯。
minors = 未成年人。不能涵蓋 young adults。
children = 兒童。過窄。
retirees = 退休人士。相反。
young grown-ups = 年輕大人。friendly tone + teens 對比下，口語感較自然。

exercises.original: The speaker jokingly referred to the university graduates as young adults finally entering the grown-up world.
exercises.zh: 講者開玩笑地把大學畢業生稱為終於進入成人世界的年輕大人。
exercises.upgrade: young grown-ups · 年輕大人；年輕成年人（較口語）

options.explanation: middle-aged adults = 中年成年人。年齡不符。
minors = 未成年人。大學畢業生通常已成年。
young grown-ups = 年輕大人。jokingly + grown-up world 正好支持這個口語說法。
children = 兒童。錯。
older adults = 年長成年人。相反。
school pupils = 學童。身份不符。

falseSynonyms.zh: 青少年；十多歲的人不等於一般的 young adults teenager 一般指 13–19 歲。只有 18–19 歲可以同時是 teen 和 adult，因此不能把 teenagers 當作 young adults 的一般同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Some older teenagers are young adults, but the categories are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 青少年；青春期人士不等於一般的 young adults adolescent 是發展階段詞，通常涵蓋青春期至成年過渡，與 young adults 有部分重疊，但很多 adolescents 尚未成年。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Adolescence overlaps with early adulthood but is not the same category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 青年；少年不等於一般的 young adults youths 的年齡範圍模糊，亦常在新聞、法律或社會服務語境中包括青少年，因此不等於 young adults。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Youths may include teenagers as well as young adults.

falseSynonyms.zh: 未成年人不等於一般的 young adults minor 是法律身份，表示未達法定成年年齡；young adults 一般強調已進入成人階段，因此兩者不能直接互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A minor is legally underage; a young adult is generally an adult.

falseSynonyms.zh: 大學生不等於一般的 young adults 很多大學生是 young adults，但學生是教育身份；不是所有 young adults 都讀大學，也不是所有 college students 都屬同一人生階段。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON College student describes education status, not simply age.

falseSynonyms.zh: 年輕專業人士不等於一般的 young adults young professionals 是 young adults 中一個較窄群體，通常指已進入專業職場的人，不能涵蓋所有年輕成年人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Young professionals are one subgroup of young adults.

falseSynonyms.zh: 應屆／新近畢業生不等於一般的 young adults new graduates 是教育與職涯狀態，不是一般年齡詞；很多 young adults 並不是剛畢業。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON New graduate describes a recent educational transition, not an age group.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成年人；大人不等於一般的 young adults grown-ups 泛指成年人，不特別表示年輕，因此範圍遠大於 young adults。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Grown-ups includes adults of all ages.
